scope: Primary-study applicability and supplemental monitoring guidance for five endocrine monotherapy suites. NCCP eligibility, dose and safety rules take precedence. These research summaries neither authorize treatment nor imply independent clinical validation.

00253.title: EBCTCG: adjuvant tamoxifen benefit in ER-positive breast cancer
00253.population: Individual-patient meta-analysis of 20 randomized trials,21,457 women; ER-positive efficacy population 10,645. About 5 years of tamoxifen versus no adjuvant tamoxifen.
00253.primary_endpoint: Breast-cancer recurrence and mortality rate ratios by follow-up period.
00253.interpretation: In ER-positive disease, recurrence rate ratios were 0.53 during years 0–4 and 0.68 during years 5–9; breast-cancer mortality was reduced by about one-third through 15 years.
00253.limitations: Relative effects are not an individual absolute benefit. Absolute benefit depends on baseline recurrence risk. Historical adjuvant evidence does not quantify benefit in metastatic disease or ER-negative disease.

separate_indication_evidence.title: ATLAS: duration review after five years
separate_indication_evidence.population: 6,846 ER-positive women within 12,894 randomized participants who had completed 5 years of tamoxifen.
separate_indication_evidence.primary_endpoint: Recurrence and breast-cancer mortality after allocation to continue to 10 years or stop at 5 years.
separate_indication_evidence.interpretation: Years 5–14 recurrence:21.4% versus 25.1%; breast-cancer mortality:12.2% versus 15.0%. Extended treatment increased pulmonary embolus risk (RR 1.87) and endometrial-cancer risk (3.1% versus 1.6% during years 5–14).
separate_indication_evidence.limitations: A planned risk–benefit discussion, not automatic ten-year treatment for everyone. Benefit and harm populations differ: cancer efficacy is ER-positive, safety analyses include all receptor groups. Published correction is listed.

00254.title: ATAC: anastrozole as initial adjuvant therapy
00254.population: 6,241 postmenopausal women randomized to anastrozole 1 mg or tamoxifen 20 mg daily for 5 years; hormone-receptor-positive subgroup 5,216.
00254.interpretation: HR-positive subgroup: DFS HR 0.86 (95% CI 0.78–0.95); time-to-recurrence HR 0.79 (0.70–0.89). Absolute recurrence difference favouring anastrozole was 4.3 percentage points at 10 years.
00254.limitations: Overall mortality did not differ significantly (HR 0.95,95% CI 0.84–1.06). Fractures were more frequent during active anastrozole treatment. These figures describe postmenopausal adjuvant treatment and must not be used as metastatic prognosis or evidence for AI monotherapy with functioning ovaries.

00371.title: BIG 1-98: letrozole as adjuvant therapy
00371.population: 8,010 postmenopausal women with hormone-receptor-positive early breast cancer; monotherapy comparison 4,922, letrozole versus tamoxifen for 5 years.
00371.primary_endpoint: Disease-free survival including recurrence, second primaries and death; monotherapy median follow-up 8.7 years.
00371.interpretation: Intention-to-treat DFS HR 0.86 (95% CI 0.78–0.96); OS HR 0.87 (0.77–0.999). Sequential schedules did not significantly improve outcomes over letrozole alone.
00371.limitations: 619 tamoxifen participants crossed to letrozole; crossover-adjusted estimates differ from intention-to-treat and must not be mixed. This is adjuvant evidence, not a benefit estimate for neoadjuvant or metastatic treatment.

additional_evidence.title: MA.17: extended adjuvant letrozole after tamoxifen
additional_evidence.population: 5,187 postmenopausal women after 5 years of tamoxifen; planned 5 years letrozole versus placebo.
additional_evidence.interpretation: At 30 months median follow-up, DFS HR 0.58 (95% CI 0.45–0.76); distant DFS HR 0.60 (0.43–0.84). Overall OS was not significantly improved (HR 0.82,0.57–1.19).
additional_evidence.limitations: Stopped early for benefit. Supports a specific post-tamoxifen extension strategy, not indefinite treatment or automatic extension after every previous AI course.

additional_evidence.title: P 024: neoadjuvant letrozole
additional_evidence.population: 337 postmenopausal women with untreated ER/PgR-positive primary breast cancer, initially unsuitable for breast-conserving surgery; 4 months letrozole versus tamoxifen.
additional_evidence.interpretation: Clinical response 55% versus 36%; breast-conserving surgery 45% versus 35%.
additional_evidence.limitations: Short preoperative response study, not a survival trial. Clinical reassessment and surgical planning remain essential; the trial duration must not override NCCP's individualized 4–8 month neoadjuvant window.

00376.title: IES: switch to exemestane after tamoxifen
00376.population: 4,724 postmenopausal women disease-free after 2–3 years of adjuvant tamoxifen; switch to exemestane versus continued tamoxifen, to total 5 years. ER-positive/unknown analysis 4,599.
00376.primary_endpoint: Breast-cancer-free survival was the principal long-term endpoint of interest, censoring intercurrent deaths.
00376.interpretation: At 10 years, BCFS absolute difference 4.0 percentage points (95% CI 1.2–6.7), HR 0.81 (0.72–0.92), favouring exemestane.
00376.limitations: Overall survival difference was not statistically significant in ER-positive/unknown analysis (HR 0.89,0.78–1.01; p=.08). This switch strategy is not 5 additional years after tamoxifen and is not evidence for premenopausal exemestane without ovarian suppression or for a metastatic survival estimate.

00361.title: CONFIRM: fulvestrant 500 mg versus 250 mg
00361.population: 736 postmenopausal women with ER-positive locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer after prior endocrine therapy.
00361.primary_endpoint: Original trial: progression-free survival. This publication reports final overall survival at 75.3% mortality maturity.
00361.interpretation: Median OS 26.4 versus 22.3 months; HR 0.81 (95% CI 0.69–0.96), nominalp=.02, for 500 mg versus 250 mg.
00361.limitations: Dose-comparison trial, not evidence against current CDK 4/6 combinations. Final OS testing had no multiplicity adjustment. The 250 mg comparator is a historical standard-dose arm, not evidence to override an individual hepatic dose adjustment.

additional_evidence.title: FALCON: separately labelled endocrine-naive context
additional_evidence.population: 462 postmenopausal endocrine-therapy-naive women with HR-positive/HER 2-negative locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer.
additional_evidence.interpretation: Fulvestrant 500 mg versus anastrozole 1 mg: median PFS 16.6 versus 13.8 months, HR 0.797 (95% CI 0.637–0.999).
additional_evidence.limitations: Endocrine-naive population differs from NCCP 00361's listed post-adjuvant anti-oestrogen relapse/progression indications. This trial does not broaden the card's prescribing eligibility.

additional_evidence.title: FALCON final overall survival
additional_evidence.population: Same randomized 462-patient FALCON population; final OS 68% mature.
additional_evidence.primary_endpoint: Prespecified final overall-survival analysis; not formally powered for OS.
additional_evidence.interpretation: No significant OS difference:44.8 versus 42.7 months; HR 0.97 (95% CI 0.77–1.21),p=.7579.
additional_evidence.limitations: Nonvisceral subgroup signal was not statistically significant. Do not claim a proven OS advantage. Reviewed 2025 erratum corrects author qualifications, not outcomes.

monitoring_guidance.context: After curative treatment; not advanced disease
monitoring_guidance.guidance: Annual mammography of remaining breast tissue: both breasts after conservation, contralateral breast after unilateral mastectomy. No routine CT/bone scans or tumour-marker testing to seek recurrence in an otherwise asymptomatic patient; investigate new symptoms. Review frequency is individualized; do not convert clinical follow-up frequency into CT frequency.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Annual breast imaging; symptom-triggered additional investigations
monitoring_guidance.qualification: Do not generate mammography of an absent breast. Treatment-safety laboratory monitoring is separate from recurrence surveillance.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: Offer baseline DXA to assess bone density when starting an AI if not already receiving adjuvant bisphosphonates. Also relevant to treatment-induced menopause or starting ovarian suppression. Do not routinely request DXA solely for tamoxifen monotherapy.
monitoring_guidance.qualification: Record existing antiresorptive treatment and the individualized bone plan; this is not a prerequisite blocking a partial clinical assessment.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: Assess fracture risk, exercise and calcium/vitamin D intake. If T-score>−2.0 with no additional risk factors, reassess risk/BMD every 1–2 years. For higher-risk patients starting bone-protective treatment, the statement generally recommends BMD every 2 years; significant bone loss or fracture requires earlier clinical reassessment.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Baseline, then risk-based 12–24 months; individualized sooner if indicated
monitoring_guidance.qualification: Do not turn this into a universal yearly DXA or prescribe antiresorptive treatment automatically. Adjuvant recurrence-prevention bisphosphonates and treatment of established bone metastases are different indications.

monitoring_guidance.context: Locally advanced/metastatic disease receiving systemic therapy
monitoring_guidance.guidance: Response assessment is generally every 2–4 months, tailored to disease pace, sites, burden and treatment. Less frequent monitoring may suit indolent disease. Suspected progression or new symptoms require earlier investigation regardless of the planned interval.
monitoring_guidance.qualification: Not a mandatory three-month CT-TAP for everyone; imaging modality and extent follow known disease and the consultant plan. An expected interval is not a booked appointment.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: If elevated and informative, tumour markers may supplement clinical/imaging assessment, particularly for nonmeasurable disease. Marker rise alone should not trigger treatment change.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Only when included in the consultant's monitoring plan
monitoring_guidance.qualification: No universal marker schedule; never infer response or progression from markers alone.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: If chemotherapy is indicated, endocrine treatment follows chemotherapy. Postoperative radiotherapy follows recovery and any indicated chemotherapy. AIs may overlap radiotherapy; whether tamoxifen overlaps or starts afterwards follows the radiation/medical-oncology plan. Letrozole neoadjuvant treatment is a distinct pre-surgery pathway.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Show ordered treatment phases with an optional radiotherapy/endocrine overlap
monitoring_guidance.qualification: eviQ whole-breast guidance explicitly supports concurrent AIs; partial-breast guidance permits tamoxifen or AI overlap. Do not imply all RT courses, agents or combinations have identical overlap rules.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: Verify the postmenopausal endocrine state. If age<55 with hysterectomy, or menopause is uncertain, NCCP advises FSH/LH/oestradiol assessment. Amenorrhoea alone after chemotherapy does not establish permanent menopause.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Before start and if ovarian function may recover
monitoring_guidance.qualification: A separate prescribed ovarian-suppression regimen is required when relevant; these monotherapy cards must not silently add or authorize OFS.

monitoring_guidance.source_section: NCCP Tests and regimen-specific complications; ACOG 601
monitoring_guidance.guidance: Baseline FBC/renal/liver profile; ECG if clinically indicated. During treatment, LFT/INR/ECG or ophthalmology assessment as clinically indicated. NCCP recommends annual gynaecological examination; investigate abnormal bleeding promptly. Routine asymptomatic endometrial ultrasound/biopsy is not a screening requirement unless an individualized high-risk plan indicates otherwise.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Baseline; annual gyn review; symptom/risk-based other checks
monitoring_guidance.qualification: Do not confuse yearly clinical gyn review with yearly ultrasound. Include VTE, visual change and abnormal vaginal bleeding safety-net advice.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: Baseline FBC/renal/liver profile; ongoing liver profile as clinically indicated. Assess injection-site symptoms and bleeding/anticoagulant risk. First 28-day cycle has injections onDays 1 and 15; subsequent cycles haveDay 1 only.
monitoring_guidance.timing: Baseline; Day 1 and 15 initially; then every 28 days
monitoring_guidance.qualification: No routine mandatory ECG/echo schedule is specified by this monotherapy protocol; cardiac surveillance may still be indicated by comorbidity or other treatment.

monitoring_guidance.guidance: Use the source minimal-emetic-risk category. Routine antiemetic premedication is not usually needed; symptomatic treatment follows local policy. These monotherapies do not carry a routine G-CSF prophylaxis schedule.
monitoring_guidance.timing: As needed rather than a chemotherapy premedication calendar
monitoring_guidance.qualification: Do not import steroid courses, neutrophil-nadir graphics, central-line or pump logistics from chemotherapy. Other concomitant treatments retain their own supportive-care requirements.

implementation_boundaries: Prefer continuous-treatment orientation for daily tablets, with early adjustment and long-term review periods; do not invent 21-day cycles or predicted neutropenia nadirs.
Keep expected milestone content separate from ordered, booked, completed and reviewed states. A clinical team must set and verify those states.
Patient-facing evidence numbers describe study groups, not personal prognosis, and should remain linked to setting, comparator, endpoint and follow-up.
Oncotype triage is outside this batch. Trial results do not calculate or override an individual's chemotherapy decision.

No universal three-month echo applies to these five endocrine monotherapies. Tamoxifen's source-based, clinically indicated ECG must remain visible. Co-prescribed HER 2 therapy or CDK 4/6 inhibitors require their own monitoring cards.
Independent clinical/pharmacy review remains pending; source-traceable development verification is not external validation.
